reports.title: Rhian Roberts: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths
Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

promises.quote: On arrival at ICU the clerking-in doctor requested a toxicology screen to include paracetamol and salicylate levels (notwithstanding that blood tests to include this were already in hand) and there was no evidence available at the inquest to establish whether or not the toxicology screen requested by the doctor was undertaken and if not why not.
promises.summary: Added to ITU safety brief that doctors must verbally communicate any specific required tests and nurses must check management plans when away.

promises.quote: An internal investigation by the health board following Mrs Roberts' death rightly established that action needed to be taken to update or modify the SOP for communicating of life-threatening blood results directly with clinical areas and an action plan indicated that this would be completed by the 30th of June 2021.
promises.summary: Updated and approved SOP for telephoning reports and results as of 20 July 2021.

promises.quote: A new process to support the services to deliver timely investigations was commenced in April 2021.
promises.summary: Daily review panel led by Corporate Patient Safety Team to oversee investigations of level 3-5 incidents.

concerns.quote: On arrival at ICU the clerking-in doctor requested a toxicology screen to include paracetamol and salicylate levels (notwithstanding that blood tests to include this were already in hand) and there was no evidence available at the inquest to establish whether or not the toxicology screen requested by the doctor was undertaken and if not why not.

An internal investigation by the health board following Mrs Roberts' death rightly established that action needed to be taken to update or modify the SOP for communicating of life-threatening blood results directly with clinical areas and an action plan indicated that this would be completed by the 30th of June 2021. At the time of the inquest on the 13th of July, the proposed update remained in draft form only and had not yet been approved.
concerns.hazard: draft SOP for life‑threatening blood result communication not approved

concerns.quote: I am concerned that the continual delays in investigating adverse incidents, sharing learning and implementing actions following the same, create risks to patient safety.
concerns.hazard: delays in investigating adverse incidents and implementing actions

links.explanation: Both reports highlight delays in acting on investigation findings or adverse incident reviews as a risk to patient safety. The earlier report focuses on delays in investigating incidents and implementing actions, while the later report stresses that untimely action on arising findings could lead to deaths.
